target.statement: AUROC of MGBOD on the smallest UCI dataset (e.g., Lymphography) as reported in the main comparison table

compute.basis: Algorithm 1 is O(|A||U|^2) per view and Algorithm 3 is O(|A||U|^2 log|U|); Lymphography has ~148 samples and 18 attributes, so a CPU run takes seconds to minutes; the main cost is installing dependencies and downloading the small UCI dataset.

blockers: Code repository may be incomplete or outdated (only a GitHub link is given; no explicit configs or data scripts mentioned in the paper)
Some datasets in the paper are derived by downsampling classes from larger public datasets, so the exact preprocessing may need to be re-implemented
title: Fuzzy Granule Density-Based Outlier Detection with Multi-Scale Granular Balls
